one_liner: Time tracking and project management software with reporting and online invoicing.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 for user-facing integrations and Personal Access Tokens for script/internal use.
verdict_reason: Harvest provides a well-documented v2 REST API supporting OAuth2 and Personal Access Tokens, allowing full access to time tracking, projects, clients, and invoicing.

evidence.quote: The Harvest API v2 is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes.
